body.name: Admissible physical source event \(H_{\mathrm{slice}}(S,\ell)\)
body.construction: For \(S\in\Pi\) and a consistent \(|\mathrm{LIT}|\)-bit label \(\ell\), \(H_{\mathrm{slice}}(S,\ell)\) is defined exactly when every asserted action-value literal \((a,x)\) names a RAND or CTF-RAND action \(a\in S\) at a catalogued value, every asserted request literal \((j,v,x)\) names an endpoint \(v\) READ by \(S\) that occurs in the transformed ancestry requested by \(C_j\), no indexed action or READ endpoint receives two values, and no other or unrecorded equality is imposed. When defined, it is the event that every asserted action records its asserted value and every asserted READ endpoint equals its asserted value.
